title: Deployment rails and activation schedule for enterprise tenants
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Goal: define a repeatable set of 'deployment rails' (configuration, gating, and rollback policies) plus a tenant-level activation schedule that maps customer commitments to code releases, upgrade windows, and Ops runbooks. This ticket captures the Q2 plan for enterprise isolated deployments (VPC/on-prem) that balances aggressive time-to-activation with safety controls for compliance customers. Key outputs: activation calendar with cohort buckets, a commitment matrix (tiers: pilot / limited / general), acceptance gates for security/compliance, automated preflight checks, and a lightweight rollback playbook. We will align with Eng on rollout automation, Design on onboarding flows, and Support for activation runbooks. Success metrics: average activation lead time, % of activations without manual intervention, post-activation incidents per 100 activations, and time-to-first-response for activation errors.
acceptance_criteria: Activation calendar defined with cohort dates and owner for each tenant
Commitment matrix and SLA template approved by Legal and Sales
Preflight checklist automated in CI for on-prem bundles
Runbook and rollback playbook documented and reviewed by Support
Pilot activation executed with two beta customers and metrics captured
